a little piece of my heart, for youS

My darling Sanvi,

We met on Bumble, but I remember our beginning through the conversations that followed. I came into them hoping for something real. Somewhere along the way, you became the person I’d keep thinking about after we’d finished talking.

And then you casually brought the gharwale into our future. You may have said it lightly, cuto, but I remembered. I liked knowing you could picture us going somewhere. I’d been hoping you could.

Then there’s “baby.” You’ve only called me that a few times, and I still catch myself smiling about it. Such a small word, but hearing it from you makes me feel close to you. Phir se sunna achha lagega.

I’m excited to finally meet you, tease you, and see those gorgeous eyes in person. I also want to learn the quieter things: what worries you, what comforts you, when you need someone to listen. I want to take the time to know you properly, baby girl.

Happy Princess Day, my highness.
I can’t wait to see where we go from here.

Always yours,me. ♡
P.S. “Baby” is a very unfair advantage. Use it wisely.
